work_package.title: Bind Standards Guidance Use to Responsive Decision Traceability
work_package.current_state: PR #187 established a bounded non-authoritative guidance contract and schema, but repository truth has no canonical trace connecting an applied guidance item to a Responsive decision surface, evidence references, exceptions, conflict disposition, and the resulting non-authority decision rationale.
work_package.target_state: A schema-backed trace envelope and deterministic validator bind each applied or rejected guidance item to its Responsive decision context, evidence references, exceptions, conflict disposition, and bounded outcome without turning guidance into authority or correctness evidence.

measurable_current_state.statement: PR #187 established a bounded non-authoritative guidance contract and schema, but repository truth has no canonical trace connecting an applied guidance item to a Responsive decision surface, evidence references, exceptions, conflict disposition, and the resulting non-authority decision rationale.
measurable_current_state.measurement: Measured by the absence of a guidance-to-decision trace schema, canonical decision-surface linkage, positive and negative fixtures, deterministic diagnostics, CI wiring, and documentation or STATUS parity.

measurable_target_state.statement: Every applied, rejected, excepted, or conflict-blocked guidance item is linked to a bounded Responsive decision context and fails closed on missing provenance, decision identity, evidence, exception, conflict, authority, or boundary semantics.
measurable_target_state.measurement: Accepted only when valid and negative fixtures cover missing or divergent guidance identity, decision-surface mismatch, absent evidence references, unrecorded exceptions, unresolved conflicts, authority substitution, lifecycle drift, and forbidden readiness or correctness upgrades under exact-head CI.

target_capability.statement: Responsive can validate repository-local traceability from non-authoritative guidance use to a bounded decision outcome without treating guidance, trace prose, CI, or merge state as decision authority or responsive-correctness evidence.
target_capability.measurement: A canonical trace contract, deterministic diagnostics, positive and negative fixtures, primary CI wiring, documentation, command-index, and STATUS parity remain mutually consistent.

work_package.expected_project_delta: Use of temporary UX/UI guidance becomes explicitly traceable and auditable at the Responsive decision boundary, preventing invisible rule application, authority substitution, or unsupported correctness conclusions.
allowed_work: Define a canonical guidance-use trace envelope that pins guidance item identity, Responsive decision surface, evidence references, applicability, exceptions, conflict disposition, and bounded outcome.

Add valid and negative fixtures for missing or divergent identity, decision-surface mismatch, absent evidence, unrecorded exceptions, unresolved conflicts, authority substitution, lifecycle drift, and boundary upgrades.
Add a deterministic fail-closed validator and align primary CI, command-index, documentation, and STATUS where directly affected.
forbidden_work: Do not make a guidance-use trace a replacement for repository contracts, Stage Anchors, validators, Kernel decisions, Project Gate authority, project-specific evidence, or Responsive decision ownership.
Do not create submitted evidence, mutate Issue #8, or run or authorize real pilot execution.
Do not infer that a recorded trace proves the guidance was correct, universally applicable, or observed in live rendering.
Do not author or accept production_ready as a payload claim; production readiness remains a derived audit conclusion.
Do not claim release_ready, live_render_validated, export_json_validated, accessibility_passed, pixel_perfect, or responsive_correctness_validated.
Do not treat trace completeness, guidance conformance, CI success, merged PRs, catalog completion, or Work Package completion as domain evidence.
must_deliver: Guidance-use to Responsive-decision trace contract and schema.
Deterministic validator with positive and negative coverage for identity, decision surface, evidence, applicability, exceptions, conflicts, authority, lifecycle, and boundary upgrades.
Primary validation-chain, command-index, documentation, and STATUS parity where directly affected.
must_preserve: Rolling queue remains a historical reconciled archive, not the execution driver.
Controller selection must come only from planning/EV4_AUTOMATION_WORK_PACKAGE_CATALOG.json.
Quality gates, CI, review, and evidence boundaries remain mandatory.
Technical evidence claims remain false unless real evidence gates pass.
Catalog replenishment is state-driven and must not block active Work Package execution.
Catalog replenishment must respect the single-active-mutation-PR policy.
definition_of_done: The measurable target state is met by schema-backed or validator-backed repository evidence.
The selected PR slice remains reviewable and stays under this Work Package ID.
No repository authority, submitted evidence, pilot authorization, authored production-readiness claim, or forbidden readiness/correctness claim is produced by the Work Package.

split_rule.principle: A Work Package may be large in objective, but each PR must remain reviewable.

allowed_pr_slices.title: guidance-decision trace contract and schema
allowed_pr_slices.objective: Define guidance identity, Responsive decision-surface linkage, evidence, exception, conflict, lifecycle, and non-authority trace semantics.
allowed_pr_slices.review_boundary: Reviewable PR slice under the same Work Package ID; no unrelated micro-objective may be introduced.

allowed_pr_slices.title: trace fixtures, validator, and CI
allowed_pr_slices.objective: Add deterministic positive and negative trace coverage plus primary validation-chain wiring.
allowed_pr_slices.review_boundary: Reviewable PR slice under the same Work Package ID; no unrelated micro-objective may be introduced.

allowed_pr_slices.title: trace documentation and STATUS parity
allowed_pr_slices.objective: Record trace guarantees and remaining authority, evidence, observation, readiness, and correctness limitations.
allowed_pr_slices.review_boundary: Reviewable PR slice under the same Work Package ID; no unrelated micro-objective may be introduced.

blocked_if: Required guidance identity, Responsive decision surface, evidence reference, applicability, exception, conflict, or lifecycle semantics cannot be determined from repository truth.
The trace would replace or reinterpret repository contracts, validators, Stage Anchors, Kernel decisions, Project Gate authority, project-specific evidence, or Responsive decision ownership.

Trace completeness or guidance conformance would be promoted to submitted evidence, pilot authorization, production, release, live-render, export, accessibility, pixel, or responsive-correctness evidence.
completion_record_requirements: Record selected Work Package ID and PR slice ID in the PR body.
List files changed, validators changed, and CI commands run.
State commands not run and why.
Record whether catalog replenishment was checked and whether it was non-mutating, same-PR in-scope, or blocked by single-active-PR policy.
Record remaining risks and the next safe human action.
